title: A snail's shell
why: Follow the spiral round and round: the snail grows its own hard shell to hold its soft body.
credit: “Snail Shell (Photogrammetry)” by Meshfinder, CC BY 4.0, via Sketchfab

title: A crab's armour
why: Look at the hard outer shell, the jointed legs and the claws: a crab wears its skeleton on the outside.
credit: “Asian Shore Crab” by RISD Nature Lab, CC BY 4.0, via Sketchfab
